intro.heading: Research at BAUST
paragraphs: Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST) is committed to advancing knowledge through quality research and scholarly publication. Across its faculties and departments, teachers and students engage in research that addresses real engineering, scientific and business challenges — supported and coordinated by the university's Research and Publication Cell.

The Cell promotes a vibrant research culture, oversees the university's publications and newsletter, and facilitates collaboration, dissemination and recognition of research output across every department.

cell.heading: Research & Publication Cell
cell.description: The Research and Publication Cell coordinates research activities and scholarly publishing across the university. It is administered by a Director and Deputy Director, supported by a dedicated team.
